features.name: Reverberating Quintessence
features.description:
At 1st level, you are immune to the deafened condition and have tremorsense 10 ft. Advantage on saves against effects that deal thunder damage.

At 3rd level: resistance to thunder damage.
At 6th level: tremorsense extends to 20 ft.

features.name: Signature Sound
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, cast *alarm* (audible only) once without a spell slot or material components. 1/long rest.

At 3rd level: spend 3 sorcery points to cast *shatter* or *silence* without a spell slot or material components.

features.name: Sonic Savant
features.description:
Beginning at 6th level, when you use Metamagic on a spell that deals thunder damage, deafens creatures, or silences/magnifies sounds:

* 1-sorcery-point Metamagic options cost 0 instead.
* All other Metamagic options cost half (rounded up).

Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

features.name: Sound and Fury
features.description: At 14th level, your thunder resistance becomes immunity. When you cast a damaging spell, you can change the damage type to thunder. If the spell also imposes a condition, you can impose deafened instead. Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

features.name: Resounding Spellcasting
features.description:
Beginning at 18th level, your thunder-dealing cantrips affect even those who succeed on saves (half damage, no extra effect).

Also, when you cast a 1st–5th level sorcerer spell dealing thunder damage, you can maximize its damage dice. First use per long rest: no penalty. Each subsequent use before a long rest: 2d12 force damage per spell level (ignores resistance/immunity).
